title: Implement complete operator CLI commands for lifecycle budget stop and limits
acceptance_criteria: mike_trade/cli.py exposes build_parser, main and a CANONICAL_COMMANDS tuple containing every canonical command listed in this task, and each entry parses in tests
python -m mike_trade.cli is the entry point, and exit codes 0/2/3/4/5 follow the documented meanings
stop invokes no order cancellation, protective-stop cancellation or position close in tests
pause and pause-symbol leave fill handling, protective/trailing management and reconciliation active and block only new entries, as asserted against service doubles

For a LIVE account, close, close-all, flatten, live-enable, live-start, entry-limits-reset, trail-policy-set, strategy-*/symbols-* mutations and trail-reconcile exit 3 with zero service side effects unless --confirm-live YES or CONFIRM_LIVE=YES is supplied
live-disable, pause, pause-symbol and entries-disable succeed without live confirmation
close, close-all and flatten exit 4 when the engine heartbeat is stale or absent, and a test asserts that no queued or pending order intent is persisted
live-enable and live-start refuse to proceed when live-preflight fails
signals, evaluations, events, logs and health dispatch to mike_trade.controls.history_commands.run_history_command via lazy import
report commands delegate to the reporting modules, and JSON output renders Decimal values as strings with masked account identifiers
tests/unit/test_operator_commands.py contains passing positive and negative tests and uses no network access or broker credentials
forbidden_changes: create or edit mike_trade/controls/history_commands.py or mike_trade/observability/metrics.py
make stop cancel protective stops or liquidate positions
persist queued or deferred order intents when the engine is offline
bypass live confirmation for order-affecting LIVE commands
duplicate risk, sizing, reconciliation or order business logic inside CLI handlers
print secrets or full account identifiers
access live broker credentials or create real broker orders
run broad test suites or backtests
